title: From hunch to verified
description: A NOC operator shares a hedged hunch; later in the thread an outcome confirms it. Tests trust levels: the knowledge ends up verified with evidence.
subject: TRN-176 optical levels after module swap

incident.summary: Optical levels low on TRN-176 after a module swap

messages.text: hey, anyone around? TRN-176 at Hervanta, the module was swapped like half an hour ago and the dashboard still shows optical levels low. is that normal or did something go wrong?
I'm on site 👍 just checked with the meter, RX is low here too. link is UP tho
I *think* the 4.0 TX-3000s need a few minutes to settle the optics after a swap? not sure at all, just something I remember from last spring
Haven't seen that myself. Don't swap it again yet, give it some time.
ok I'll wait, going to get a coffee ☕
lol kahvi is always the answer
back. ok so levels came up on their own, took about 10 min. traffic is fine
Good to know, I'll remember that for the 4.0 boxes.

items.summary: On TX-3000 units installed from 2020, optical levels can read low for about ten minutes after a module swap; wait before replacing the module again.
items.diagnosis: optics still settling after the swap
items.action: Wait about ten minutes and re-check the optical levels before replacing the module again.
avoid: replace the module again straight away
items.evidence: seq 8: 'levels came up on their own, took about 10 min'
